summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the "WomanLog" app, specifically step 5 out of 6 in the setup process. The main content of this screen is a language selection menu. Users are prompted to select their preferred language from a list of options. The available languages include:

- According to phone settings
- English
- Deutsch
- Français
- Italiano
- Español
- Português
- Dansk
- Eesti
- Latviešu
- Lietuvių
- Magyar
- Nederlands
- Norsk
- Polski
- Svenska

The user can select a language by tapping the corresponding radio button. At the bottom of the screen, there is a "NEXT" button, which the user can tap to proceed to the next step in the setup process.
